scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler dev -c wrangler.web.jsonc -c wrangler.mcp.jsonc --persist-to .wrangler/state --port 8787
scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply advent-day-33-support --local -c wrangler.web.jsonc --persist-to .wrangler/state
scripts.db:seed: wrangler d1 execute advent-day-33-support --local -c wrangler.web.jsonc --persist-to .wrangler/state --file seed.sql
scripts.dry-run: npm run build && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.mcp.jsonc --dry-run && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.web.jsonc --dry-run
scripts.deploy:web: npm run build && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.web.jsonc
scripts.deploy:all: npm run build && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.mcp.jsonc && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.web.jsonc && tsx scripts/secrets.ts
